channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Qatar, France call for opening of Hormuz and Gaza ceasefire implementation
item.description: Qatari and French leaders stress need to restore freedom of navigation in Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: One killed, eight injured in attack on Saudi Arabia’s King Fahd airport
item.description: Injured immediately transported to hospitals as aviation authority says updates will be forthcoming.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC vows invasion as defence doctrine turns ‘offensive’
item.description: Iran's IRGC threatens to invade any country that attacks it under a new 'offensive and asymmetrical' doctrine.

item.title: US orders departure of personnel from Saudi Arabia, citing Houthi threat
item.description: US State Department says Iran-aligned Houthis have 'increasingly ⁠⁠engaged in hostilities' against Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Tehran displays mock installation of Trump behind bars
item.description: An Iranian performer in Tehran’s busy Tajrish Square has impersonated US President Donald Trump behind bars.

item.title: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate
item.description: The warning to US officials comes as at least three people die in the latest strikes at an airport and an oil field.

item.title: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
item.description: Brian Stack was crossing a street in Dublin in 1983 when he was shot in the back of the neck and died 18 months later.

item.title: Swimmer, 65, killed in shark attack off South Africa's east coast
item.description: Janine Lochrenberg, 65, was out on her daily morning swim with her club when she was attacked, her family tell the BBC.
